sloka: एतेन हि नृशंसेन मारीचेन अकृत आत्मना ।वने विचरता पूर्वम् हिंसिता मुनि पुंगवाः ॥३-४३-३९॥
transliteration: etena hi nṛśaṁsena mārīcena akṛta ātmanā ।vane vicaratā pūrvam hiṁsitā muni puṁgavāḥ ॥3-43-39॥

translations.english: Many kings who were great archers who set out on hunting expedition were killed by him. Therefore, this animal deserves to be killed.
